page.overview:
Who is Adalbert Kamentin?

His activities attracted the attention of the Vision who traveled to the region to put an end to Kamentin's murderous creations. The Vision allowed himself to be captured by Kamentin and Kixor to be brought to the killers' castle.

There, the Vision and a captured female broke free from their bonds and confronted Kamentin. Kamentin unleashed his plants on the two, but when they broke free, the frightened botanist attempted to flee the scene.

As he ran away from the Vision, Kamentin tripped and ended up falling into the maw of one of his own plants and was eaten alive.
